identification: Forged iron blacksmith's leg (post) vice, about 103 cm overall, fairly light pattern with short jaws (estimate 3.5-4 in / 90-100 mm jaw width from photo proportions). Screw with box/nut, tommy bar, flat leaf spring between the legs, mounting bracket/strap piece hanging at the screw and a square block at the pivot on the leg; long leg ends in a bolt/nut. Heavy surface rust. No maker's stamp visible in the single photo.

viewing_check: Measure jaw width; look for a maker stamp on the front jaw face or box (Peter Wright, Brooks, Fisher). Check the screw and box thread run freely and are not stripped, the spring is intact, the mounting bracket and wedge are all there, jaws not cracked.
